title: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
source_url: Not available in search results - refer to rbi.org.in
description: <cite index="44-7">The directions rewrite rules on recovery agent conduct, restrict the use of device-locking technology in loan recovery, and create a compensation mechanism for borrowers subjected to wrongful recovery action.</cite> <cite index="44-8">The directions take effect from January 1, 2027, giving banks a compliance window of roughly five months to overhaul recovery policies, contracts, and technology systems.</cite>
